svg.title: Schematic detail of the floor of the shell garden at Kai no Hama: scallop shells laid flat and overlapping in a mortar bed on a concrete slab, with shallow water running over them.

g.text: Shell on mortar on concrete, and nothing else.
The shells are laid by hand, flat, close enough
that the eye reads one pale floor rather than a
About a million scallop shells went into these pools. They were bought
as waste from the seafood processing along this coast.
SCHEMATIC — a build-up drawn to explain how the floor is made, not to build from.
